Title: Azure Spring Cloud service is now in private preview

Body.Content:
Azure Spring Cloud, a fully managed Spring Cloud service jointly built and operated with Pivotal, is now in private preview.

Spring Boot eliminates boilerplate code and helps you build robust Java applications quickly. Developers will love how Spring Cloud brings modern microservices patterns to Spring Boot applications. The Azure Spring Cloud, a managed fully service, makes it quick, safe, and easy to deploy and operate Spring Boot applications in the cloud.

Learn more

Sign up for the private preview
